transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get started. We're here to review the retirement plan for the legacy analytics cluster. As we all know, the warehouse migration has passed its standard functional checks, and the current plan lists June 30 as the decommission date. Before I make a final approval, I want to make sure we've completed the normal review process — specifically the check-ins with infrastructure and data governance. Has anyone from those teams had a chance to review the retirement plan yet?

transcript.text: Morgan, before you approve — I need to flag something. While checking migration logs this morning for an unrelated capacity issue, I found that the warehouse copy still needs a 48-hour read-only checksum run before the legacy cluster can be safely decommissioned. The run can start on June 30, but it means we can't actually decommission on that date — we'd need to push it back by at least 48 hours. I haven't updated the retirement ticket yet, but I wanted to make sure this was on the table before any final decision is made.

transcript.text: Morgan, I'm glad we're doing this check-in — I need to flag two critical issues from a customer-records audit I completed yesterday. First, an enterprise dashboard contract requires that a customer's analytics access must remain available through July 31, which means a June 30 decommission would put us in breach. Second, regulated records from the legacy cluster must be placed in an immutable snapshot retained for exactly 7 years. Neither of these requirements has been added to the retirement plan yet, and they need to be incorporated before any final approval.

Elena, we have two additional blockers — an enterprise dashboard contract requiring analytics access through July 31, which means June 30 (or even July 2) decommission would breach that contract, and regulated records need to go into an immutable snapshot with exactly 7 years of retention. Neither requirement is in the retirement plan yet. Given all of this, I cannot approve the June 30 decommission date as it stands. The contractually obligated date of July 31 for analytics access means we need to keep the cluster available at least through that date. The checksum run and immutable snapshot requirements need to be formally added to the retirement plan as well. Before I settle on a final decision, I want to confirm: are there any other blockers or requirements anyone is aware of that we haven't yet discussed?
